title: Linked cortical bottlenecks form a turbo code

statements.text: Connections between the low-dimensional bottlenecks of the sensory modalities form an auto-associative network that supports loopy belief propagation, which makes it a turbo code approaching the Shannon limit for transmission over noisy channels. SOHMs are the brain's way of running this message passing, yielding reliable perceptual inference from noisy input.
